prompt_text: Explain how a falling cat manages to turn itself over and land on its feet with nothing to push against, a puzzle that once seemed to defy the conservation of angular momentum. Write a single paragraph of about 156 words, with no title or headings.

Explain resonance using examples like a wine glass singing, a bridge swaying, and a child on a swing.

Write a story set on Rapa Nui in which villagers use ropes to rock a towering moai from side to side, 'walking' the statue upright across the island toward its platform by the sea.
